answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 57 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 12 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 57 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 740 bought sponsors, each risking real money. The wharf is the check that cannot be faked, the zenith is the price the attacker pays, and the quill is the record that outlives the epoch.
